title: Sakura Taisen
overview:
The battle for the imperial capital between the Kuronosu-kai, plotting to overthrow the government, and the Imperial Assault Force Flower Division...

In the imaginary Taisho era, a secret unit protects the imperial capital of Tokyo. By day its members are the stars of the Imperial Theater Troupe at the Grand Imperial Theater. When the alarm sounds, they climb into steam-powered armor called Koubu and fight to defend the city from demonic forces. You play Ichiro Ogami, a young officer fresh from military school, assigned to lead the all-female Flower Division.

In the adventure part, events unfold inside the Grand Imperial Theater. Wander its rooms and corridors, meet the troupe and answer within a time limit using the LIPS system - your replies build or damage each heroine's trust and change the direction of the story. In the battle part, command your units on the map to plan your strategy.

- Dramatic adventure and strategy simulation
- Animated scenes with a full voice cast
- Two discs
- Shuttle Mouse support
- Memory backup support

政府転覆をもくろむ黒之巣会と帝国華撃団・花組の帝都をめぐる戦い・・・
